name: Strict-Dominance Characterization Equivalence
statement: Vanishing separator coefficient ratio, zero dominance defect, and existence of a shared strict term-dominance certificate are equivalent.
proof: If the ratio is smaller than the reciprocal of the largest unfavorable side, logarithmic magnitudes force some favorable term to dominate every unfavorable term. Conversely, exponentiating a strict dominance certificate by a common scale makes every unfavorable-to-favorable sum ratio tend to zero.
